Transfer Information:

TLD-specific Data

EPP Code
Transfer authorization code provided by domain registrar
DNS configuration
If you have custom DNS records added for the primary domain through the DNS Manager of the hosting Control Panel, checking this option will force the domain parking procedure to add the custom records to the newly-parked domain name as well. Otherwise, the domain will be parked using the default DNS and mail settings.
Host as

You can host the new domain name as parked to existing main/addon domain or as a completely new addon domain name.

  • Addon domain - Can be used for an additional website, it has its own web and mail services.
  • Parked domain - Only a pointer to an existing website and mail service at your account.
Software
Select a software package and it will be automatically installed on the account.
WordPress + AI Assistant
Quickly and easily launch a new WordPress site, fully integrated with an AI assistant powered by Extendify. Get smart content suggestions, intuitive setup guidance, and automated tools to help you build and manage your website faster - all in one streamlined experience.
Enable server-side caching

Server-side caching is a free in-house solution based on NGINX and designed to significantly speed up your WordPress website. It is combined with a fast script hosting environment based on PHP-FPM with OPcache to give you the best possible WordPress performance at no extra cost.

Note: If you enable server-side caching, a free WordPress plugin will also be installed that automatically purges the cache when you make changes to your website.

Extra security

Add extra protection to your hosting account with our optional security services. You can enable them now and manage them at any time from your hosting Control Panel.

Extended Backups - additional backups kept for 12 months
Get extra backups on top of the default daily backups with the Extended Backups service. All account data will be backed up on the 1st and 15th day of each month, and each backup will be kept for 12 months. You will be able to restore from these backups at any time via the hosting Control Panel.
Advanced security service
The Advanced Security service covers one website and includes the following features:
  • Scanning and monitoring.
  • Additional protection.
  • Malware removal.
Enable WebApps / Node.js
WebApps is a managed platform for running server-side applications such as Node.js apps. Enabling it adds dedicated RAM to your hosting account, which is used to run your applications. You can add more dedicated RAM at any time later on.
Activate Redis Accelerated Cache
Redis Accelerated Cache speeds up your website by storing frequently requested data directly in memory, so pages are served faster and your database is under less load. It is especially effective for dynamic websites and online stores.
